harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired node1’s render script. It now resolves its bundled helper and template relative to its own location, runs with only PATH=/usr/bin:/bin from arbitrary working directories, writes the requested output, and preserves the complete report. The source template, Ubuntu 16.04.7 release, and Linux 4.4.0-210 kernel remain unchanged. Persistence was verified after reboot.
actions_performed: Verified relative and absolute output paths from /tmp and /var/tmp under a clean environment.
Confirmed the source template checksum remained unchanged.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified its changed boot identity and full application recovery.

evidence.requirement: Render works with an empty environment except PATH, from any working directory, and writes requested output
evidence.summary: Captures the original exit 127, then successful clean-environment renders from /tmp and /var/tmp using relative and absolute output paths.

evidence.requirement: Bundled branch-format helper and template are found; report contents are retained
evidence.summary: Shows the repaired location-independent script and the rendered BRANCH REPORT with Region and Shipments content.

evidence.requirement: Source template and legacy OS/kernel are preserved
evidence.summary: The template SHA-256 remains 60a2035d67e51a10515562d314f64c88029a1f2e78a15c24ae719ebdf1c28a03; Ubuntu 16.04.7 and Linux 4.4.0-210 remain installed before and after reboot.

Healthy pre-restart boot ID and application output were captured; reboot acknowledgement returned; boot ID changed from 35c87ec9-1707-4fb3-ab1d-f264d3618caa to e78cc9da-af23-4f38-aa7c-d123007edf3f; system state returned to running and the clean-environment render and application checksums recovered.
